sources.title: Claude Fable 5.1
sources.evidence: Exact claude-fable-5-1 identifier; released September 1, 2026; 1M context; adaptive thinking always on; text/image input and text output; intended for demanding reasoning and long-horizon agentic work.

sources.title: Models overview
sources.evidence: Identifies Anthropic as Claude's developer and lists Fable 5.1 among current models, all supporting tool use.

sources.title: PDF support
sources.evidence: All active models support PDF processing; PDFs are processed through text and vision. Together with the active exact-model page, supports PDF as an accepted input format.

sources.title: Claude Fable
sources.evidence: The Fable product line lists Fable 5.1's introduction on September 1, 2026 and access through Claude subscriptions, Claude Platform and partner services.

sources.title: Commercial Terms of Service
sources.evidence: The terms govern Anthropic API services, grant permission to use services subject to restrictions and reserve intellectual-property rights. Supports a descriptive proprietary classification for the hosted offering, not a named open-weight license.

sources.title: Anthropic's Transparency Hub
sources.evidence: Fable 5.1's section describes pretraining and post-training but gives no model parameter count or architectural class. States Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1 share the same underlying model with different safeguards.

sources.title: Model system cards
sources.evidence: Lists the Fable/Mythos 5.1 card and later Opus, Sonnet and Haiku 5.5 cards; used to locate the original documents.

sources.title: Claude Fable 5.1 & Claude Mythos 5.1 System Card
sources.evidence: Independently retrieved original 212-page PDF with curl and extracted full text using pdftotext. No production parameter counts or architecture class found. Parameter hits concern inference settings; the architecture reference describes a benchmark task, not this model.

sources.title: Claude Opus 5.5 System Card
sources.evidence: Independently retrieved original 230-page later card and searched full text for exact-model comparison disclosures. No production parameter count or architecture class found; parameter hits concern inference settings and the architecture reference concerns a benchmark task.

sources.title: Claude Fable 5.1 & Claude Mythos 5.1 — AI System Cards
sources.evidence: Used only to discover the original PDF URL. Technical conclusions rely on independently retrieved first-party originals, not this transcription.

sources.title: Models news
sources.evidence: Search-indexed listing dated the introduction September 15, conflicting with September 1 on the exact model documentation and Fable product page. The two explicit model sources govern the release date.

sources.title: Models.dev Claude Fable 5.1 record
sources.evidence: Followed the baseline catalog link as a discovery lead; it is not the verification basis.

sources.title: Claude Sonnet 5.5 System Card
sources.evidence: Independently retrieved original 148-page later card and searched the full text, including 41 Fable 5.1 references. No production parameter counts or architecture disclosure found; parameter mentions concern inference settings.

sources.title: Claude Haiku 5.5 System Card
sources.evidence: Independently retrieved original 144-page later card and searched the full text, including 25 Fable 5.1 references. No production parameter counts or architecture disclosure found; parameter mentions concern inference settings.

sources.title: GLM-5.3 and the spread of advanced cyber capabilities
sources.evidence: September 29, 2026 research article explicitly says Claude weights are not publicly released or provided to users. Used only to corroborate distribution policy, not to transfer technical specifications from evaluated siblings.

name.note: Exact model name and API identifier match.

family.note: Catalog normalization of the officially named Claude Fable line.

release_date.note: Exact-model documentation explicitly says released September 1, corroborated by the product page. The news listing's September 15 date conflicts and is not treated as earliest release.

open_weights.note: Exact-model access documentation describes hosted services; Anthropic separately explicitly states that Claude weights are not publicly released or provided to users.

license.note: Descriptive classification of the commercial hosted model; not an SPDX weight license.

parameters_b.note: No production count disclosed in the exact-model official documentation, original system card, or checked later Opus/Sonnet/Haiku 5.5 cards. Full-text checks distinguish inference-setting parameters and benchmark model architecture from production model size.

active_parameters_b.note: No exact active-parameter count disclosed in the checked original and later cards. No dense/MoE assumption or total-to-active equivalence is made.

architecture.note: No architecture class disclosed in the checked original and later cards. Exact-name Anthropic research and transformer-circuits.pub searches found no additional primary disclosure. Training descriptions and benchmark-task architecture references do not establish this model architecture.

modalities.note: Text/image to text is explicit; PDF is retained as a supported document input format, not a separate neural modality.

tool_call.note: Official current-model overview explicitly includes tool use for this lineup.

description.value: Claude model for demanding reasoning and long-horizon agentic work
description.note: Matches the exact-model documentation's positioning without an unsupported benchmark superlative.

summary: Confirmed identity, September 1 release, capabilities and neutral description using exact-model Anthropic documentation; classify the hosted model as proprietary and replace catalog-only attribution with primary sources. Total parameters, active parameters and architecture remain null: no disclosure found in the original 212-page system card, later Opus/Sonnet/Haiku 5.5 cards or exact-name interpretability searches. Original PDFs were successfully retrieved and searched independently; no sibling specifications or third-party transcription claims were imported.
